meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 让 Claude 接入 Linear 渠道：它会复制 Linear 适配器、注册并安装依赖。之后每个 issue 的每条评论都会触发 Claude 自动回复，无需 @提及，每个 issue 线程独立成对话。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 Linear 渠道集成时触发（如 /setup 流程）；配置完成后，每次 issue 评论都会自动响应。

say.note: 开始复制适配器并提示输入 OAuth 凭证。

say.text: 用 Personal API Key 接入 Linear
say.note: 走简化路径，之后以你的身份发帖。

say.text: 设置 webhook 并连接 Linear 团队
say.note: 引导你完成 webhook 和团队配置。

howto.what_en: Integrates Linear via Chat SDK: copies adapter, registers it, installs dependency. After setup, each issue comment triggers auto-reply without @-mention; each issue thread is a separate conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Linear channel integration, typically during NanoClaw setup or manual configuration. Once set up, it activates on every new comment in the monitored Linear team.

say_en.note: Starts copying adapter and prompts for OAuth credentials.

Set up webhook and link the Linear team
